prompt: Our processor settles each sale net of its fee, so the amount that lands in the bank (`right.csv`) is slightly smaller than the sale we recorded (`left.csv`). The fee is never more than 2.00. One of these pairs differs by considerably more than a fee and should be reported rather than absorbed. Columns are date, amount, currency, reference, description; dates look like 2024-01-31. Write a `reconify.yaml` that reconciles the files.
